reviewPolicy.zh-CN: 此文件是复核工作表，不是审校结论；所有检查项默认为 pending。
reviewPolicy.en: This file is a review worksheet, not an approval record; every check starts as pending.

reviewPolicy.zh-CN: 只有具名学科审校人完成节点、关系与知识簇检查后，才能把源图谱改为 subject-checked。
reviewPolicy.en: The source map may become subject-checked only after a named subject reviewer completes node, relation, and cluster checks.

reviewPolicy.zh-CN: 教材映射必须基于实际采用版本录入，不得从课程标准页码推测教材章节。
reviewPolicy.en: Textbook mappings must use an actually adopted edition and must not infer textbook chapters from curriculum-standard pages.

releaseConditions.en: At least one actually adopted textbook edition maps every core node.

releaseConditions.en: Revalidation clears satisfied blockers; subject review remains an independent human sign-off.
